title: Knowledge Entry
description: A single bilingual customer-support entry. Both register variants are required before the entry is eligible to ground answers (FR-014).

topic.description: Coarse-grained topic. Entries outside this set are out of scope for v1.

keywords_msa.description: Short MSA phrases used for keyword-style retrieval.

keywords_egy.description: Short Egyptian-dialect phrases (and common Arabizi forms) used for retrieval.

wording_msa.description: Final answer in Modern Standard Arabic.

wording_egy.description: Final answer in Egyptian Arabic dialect. MUST NOT contain MSA paragraphs.

last_updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); updated whenever any wording field changes.
